primary_task: Research a topic across sources and write a synthesised report with insights and citations.

requirements.name: WebSearch/WebFetch
requirements.evidence: tools: Read, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, WebSearch; 'Web research'; 'Source identification'
requirements.basis: web_search: search the public web and read result snippets | web_fetch: fetch a web page or unauthenticated API by URL; hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused

requirements.name: Read/Grep/Glob
requirements.basis: read: read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)

requirements.name: expert interviews / surveys
requirements.basis: lacks: physical devices and hardware ...; accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub

requirements.name: database queries / API integration
requirements.basis: lacks: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)

notes: Pages on hosts outside the allow-list will be refused, but web_search snippets still work. Interviews, surveys, databases are listed topics, not required steps. The tools list has no Write, so the report is returned in the reply.
